WELCOME

After I hung up my cleats, my wife Paulinha and I kept living the way football had taught us to: on the move. Two decades of chasing a quarterback career through arena leagues, overseas teams, and even football stunt work in film and TV never gave us a hometown of our own, and honestly, we didn't mind. But when we opened our first short-term rental in Green Bay, a few blocks from the Lambeau Field I grew up worshipping as a Cheesehead kid, something unexpected happened: guests didn't just enjoy the house, they connected with the story inside it.

That house taught us that a great stay isn't just about comfortable beds. It's about the stories a place tells, and the new ones guests create inside it. So we kept going. The GOAT House is our tribute to the greatest all-around athlete who ever lived: Jim Thorpe. Olympic gold medalist, pro football pioneer, a legend whose name belongs alongside anyone who's ever played the game. Every corner of this house, from the indoor court to the cinema to the sauna to the walls themselves, is built to celebrate greatness. His, and yours. We hope you create some new stories of your own during your stay.

Matthew, Paulinha, Koa and Rio

CHECK-IN AND CHECK-OUT

Check-in is after 4:00 PM. Check-out is before 11:00 AM.

WIFI / INTERNET

Network:Pigskin Journeyman JT
Password:down.set.hut

Free WiFi for your use. You are responsible for safe and appropriate use and complying with all laws. If there is any loss of service please contact us.

HEATING AND COOLING

Every room has its own mini-split unit controlled by a remote. The house runs on two separate systems, one for each side of the house. Important: every unit on the same system must be set to COOL or HEAT at the same time. If one room is cooling while another on the same system is heating, the system will crash. When in doubt, set them all the same. You will also see thermostats for the baseboard heaters on the walls. Please leave those OFF. If you would like them on, just ask us first. When running heat or AC, please keep windows and outside doors closed. We recommend 72F.

KITCHEN

The stove and oven run on propane gas. It has a built-in lighter, so just turn the knob and it lights. A quick note since many guests ask: yes, it is a gas stove, and that is normal. Dishwasher: add detergent to the dispenser inside the door, choose your cycle, and press start. Fridge and freezer: you should not need to adjust anything. If something is not cooling properly, let us know.

LAUNDRY

You will find our brand new Samsung gas washer and dryer right inside the entryway from the garage gym and basketball court. Add detergent, choose your program, and press start. A supply of detergent is provided.

CINEMA ROOM

Our private cinema has a 135 inch screen with theater sound. Turn the projector on with the Yaber remote (the black one). Use the Amazon Cube connected to the projector for all streaming. To get the full cinematic sound through the Echo Studio speakers, make sure you are watching through the Cube.

INDOOR BASKETBALL COURT

Yes, it is real, and yes, the rim is dunkable. To adjust the height, put the hook handle in and spin the hydraulic lift up or down. One house rule for the court: please use ONLY our silent foam basketballs on this hoop. No outside balls.

GYM

A full heavy-duty gym, ready for your workout. There is an Amazon Bluetooth speaker on top of the garage fridge: open the Bluetooth settings on your phone, find it, connect, and play your own music.

THE GOAT FOUNDRY

In the gym you will find the GOAT Foundry, our wall of personal greatness. If you have won medals in your own athletic career, we invite you to leave one with us and take your place on the wall.

THE OLYMPIC VILLAGE ROOM

Our tribute to Jim Thorpe's 1912 Olympics. Put on the house shirt, our homage to the 1912 US Olympic track jersey Thorpe wore, grab a medal and the head wreath, step up onto the podium, and take the photo. Tag us @PigskinJourneyman.

GAME ROOMS

Poker and board game room, PS5 lounge, Pop-A-Shot, and foosball. Help yourself.

TAKE A SHOT AT THE HOUSE RECORD

Think you can put up a score worthy of the GOAT House? Step up to the Pop-A-Shot games and see if you can qualify for one of our house record boards. We love when guests join the competition, so give it your best shot and let us know if your score belongs on the board.

SAUNA

Our custom 12 foot barrel sauna is out back with its own changing room. Turn the power on at the unit in the changing room. It heats all the way up to 100C (212F), so give it time to warm up. When you are done, please turn the unit off and switch the lights off at the door.

HOT TUB

Our 8 person Master Spas hot tub is set to 101F and can go up to 104F. Please put the cover back on carefully after every use. There are cover lift assisters to make it easy. Leaving the cover off forces the tub to use a lot of extra energy reheating, so we appreciate your help.

OUTDOOR COOKING AND FIRE PIT

The Blackstone griddle is ready for outdoor cooking. Please leave it clean for the next guests. The fire pit area has lounge seating. Please respect our 10PM quiet hours so our neighbors stay happy.

When you come in for the night, please turn off the exterior string lights, plus the front and side exterior lights. Those lights shine into our neighbors' windows, so we appreciate your help keeping the neighborhood comfortable.

AROUND THE AREA

Tennis court and patio on site. Through the Bear Creek Lakes community you also have access to an Olympic sized pool, a private lake, a sandy beach, and additional sport courts.

HOUSE RULES

Quiet times: 10PM to 8AM. We are in a residential community, so please keep noise down overnight. Breakages: accidents happen. Tell us right away. If it is minor we usually will not charge; for bigger things we will agree on a cost before you leave. Smoking: this is a smoke-free home, including the outside areas. No smoking or vaping anywhere on the property. Pets: welcome. Parties and events: not allowed. Maximum occupancy: 16 guests.

SAFETY

In an emergency call 911 immediately. The address is 54 Indian Trail Road, Jim Thorpe, PA 18229. In case of fire: exit quickly, make sure everyone is accounted for, call 911 and ask for FIRE, and give the address above. Do not re-enter until a fire officer says it is safe.

CHECK-OUT (before 11:00 AM)

These are not hard rules, just a few things our cleaners appreciate. If you are short on time, do not worry about it. We would never withhold a deposit over dishes.

  • Leave the beds unmade. No need to strip them.
  • Put used towels in the shower.
  • Load the dishwasher and start it.
  • Empty all the trash.
  • Put furniture and items back where you found them.
  • Turn the mini-splits off with the remotes, and double check the sauna unit and its lights are off.
  • Check that all doors and windows are locked.

THANK YOU

Thank you for staying with us. If anything was not right, please tell us so we can fix it for the next guest. We love reviews: Airbnb and Vrbo will send you a review request automatically. A star rating and a sentence or two about your favorite part means the world to us. Follow us: Facebook and Instagram @PigskinJourneyman. Tag your podium photo.
